investigations.title: Checkout health degraded
investigations.summary: Checkout conversion −18% since 19:00; corroborated by Jira, App Store; began 30 min after release 4.8.1. Investigation confidence high that the checkout problem is real; cause not established.
investigations.attentionReason: Core funnel degradation (Checkout conversion −18%) corroborated by 2 other sources.
investigations.confidenceReason: 3 independent sources show the degradation. This is confidence that the checkout problem is real, not that its cause is known.

evidence.statement: Analytics: Checkout conversion is 2.77% vs 3.40% baseline (−18%) since 19:00.
Jira: 4 new checkout issues since 19:20 (PAY-512, PAY-513, PAY-514, PAY-516).
Analytics: Sessions is within its normal range (+0.4% vs baseline).
App Store: Crash-free sessions (iOS) is 99.06% vs 99.72% baseline (−0.66 pts) since 19:00.
Analytics: Purchase revenue is $4,050 vs $4,800 baseline (−16%) since 19:00.
App Store: 3 reviews rated 1–2★ mention checkout since 20:12.

observed: Analytics: Checkout conversion is 2.77% vs 3.40% baseline (−18%) since 19:00.
Jira: 4 new checkout issues since 19:20 (PAY-512, PAY-513, PAY-514, PAY-516).
Analytics: Sessions is within its normal range (+0.4% vs baseline).
App Store: Crash-free sessions (iOS) is 99.06% vs 99.72% baseline (−0.66 pts) since 19:00.
Analytics: Purchase revenue is $4,050 vs $4,800 baseline (−16%) since 19:00.
App Store: 3 reviews rated 1–2★ mention checkout since 20:12.
inferred: 3 sources first degraded within 20 minutes of each other, so they likely reflect the same underlying checkout problem.
The degradation began 30 minutes after release 4.8.1 — a temporal association.
Traffic is normal, so the change is in how people convert, not in how many arrive.
unknowns: Whether release 4.8.1 is responsible — timing alone does not establish causation.
Payment-provider and server error data are not connected to Jagr.
Not checked: Play Store crash rate, Play Store reviews.

hypotheses.statement: Checkout degradation temporally associated with release 4.8.1
An unrelated factor outside the connected sources (payment provider, backend, marketing change)

investigations.likelyExplanation: Checkout conversion declined shortly after release 4.8.1 and Jira, App Store also show checkout problems. The available evidence supports a temporal correlation, but does not establish causation.
investigations.uncertainty: The data does not establish causation. Payment-provider data is not connected, so a third-party payment problem cannot be ruled out.
investigations.recommendedNextStep: Review checkout errors and crash reports associated with 4.8.1, and triage PAY-512 and PAY-513.
